items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Well Lemon was the ukulele player, he was our leader.

ctx.x: Who was singing it too fast?

Well Lemon was the ukulele player, he was our leader. Then he'd say it was grease your knuckles, grease your elbows. I said man you're playing the music too fast. I said people don't like that kind of music. I said give a swing to your music, you know what I mean? Bounce it a little bit. What you want about son?
He wants to see what the microphone is.
